integrity_statement: Analytic proof supplies all infinite or continuous-parameter conclusions; exact-rational finite regression checks are auxiliary. No independent mathematical audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Endpoint-positive linear updates for finite conservative Markov generators only; no internal-stage positivity, nonlinear SSP, broad PDE guarantee, or independent historical-priority certification. The 2021 Dawes paper was accessible only by abstract.
title: Reentrant endpoint positivity of three-stage RKL2 on a minimal Markov chain
